newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed unchanged on Tuesday on low buying by spinners and exporters, brokers at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Spinners are not buying owing to a shortage of good-quality cotton, broker Adil Nasim said.
Some exporters had bought an average quality cotton, he said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted 1,975/2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 for 2,350/2,410 and the MNH-93 for 2,375/2,425.
